stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.5.1 is a duplicate-application safety hotfix. Legacy vacancy IDs such as jobs.cz:<id> and canonical job:<id> are now merged in Dashboard, confirmed terminal history is authoritative, and Prepare now checks local submission history both in the UI and again inside the engine before opening any application form. This prevents a previously submitted vacancy from being prepared again. Final employer Submit remains manual.
